name: Yasilor
description: Yasilor was a world located within the star system of the same name, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Bajic sector. Around the year 10 ABY, it served as the homeworld of the Palkandi Brokerage House, a front organization for the criminal Tenloss Syndicate.
